title: Lil' Bits of Language  - Videos
description:
Early communication development for toddlers of busy parents so your child can achieve higher academic and social success.
*Make the most of the moments that matter.*

FREE WEEKLY RESOURCES WHEN YOU SUBSCRIBE:
📚 Animated story read-alouds for kids
🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Busy parent hacks
👩🏽‍💻 Shareable family guides
📖 Book releases, and more!

With over 30 years of combined experience, we cover many topics from lived and learned experiences:
*Speech-language pathology: language, speech, feeding, early childhood development, etc
*Published children's book authors
*Parenthood
*Children with special needs
